item.title: Expanse: Dimension Add-On
item.creator: Tsunami Studios
item.description:
Explore the Moon Dimension! Use tech from a crashed alien probe to build a rocket ship and blast off. Build your lunar base with tons of new blocks, then explore and battle through the vast, infinite expanse.

+ Infinite world generation.

+ Smelt steel, build a rocket, turn water into fuel and take flight!

+ New space suit with oxygen system.
item.changelog:
+ Improved server-side terrain generation performance.
+ Enhanced visuals with expanded Vibrant Visuals support, new particles and updated textures.
+ Added optional add-on settings for more control.
+ Bug fixes!

faqEntries.heading: Is the Moon randomly generated?
faqEntries.content: Yes, the Moon is a custom, procedurally generated dimension. No two playthroughs are the same, and nothing that happens there affects your Overworld.

faqEntries.heading: How do I reach the Moon?
faqEntries.content: Easy answer: build a rocket. Hard answer: any way you want. Nothing stops you from rigging your own launch contraption or just flying high enough to escape Earth's gravity. As long as you where a spacesuit, there's no endless tech tree gatekeeping your trip.

faqEntries.heading: What's actually up there?
faqEntries.content: A hostile, beautiful alien world. Craters, quarries, and industrial complexes built by ancient machines: living probes sent from a distant civilization to harvest the Moon's resources.

faqEntries.heading: What mechanics will I need to master?
faqEntries.content: Oxygen management with tanks and canisters, along with the materials that keep them running. Some familiar tools just don't work up there, and some Moon materials, like water, are worth more than diamonds ever were back on the Overworld.

faqEntries.heading: Can I build a lunar base?
faqEntries.content: Yes, as long as there's oxygen in the tank, you can survive on the Moon's surface without needing a space suit. Place tanks strategically around your build to create a working lunar base, or set up outposts and checkpoints as you explore. As a matter of fact, we advise it.

faqEntries.heading: Do I need to grind a massive tech tree to get started?
faqEntries.content: No. The core loop of rocket, oxygen, and landing is simple enough to learn in one trip. The real challenge lies in actually surviving and exploring this hostile environment.

item.howToTitle: Add to new or existing world

howToEntries.heading: Build a Rocket
howToEntries.content:
-Hydrogen Engine (base) - powers the launch.

-Up to 5 Oxygen Tanks stacked on top.

-Command Module on top.

howToEntries.heading: Fly to the Moon
howToEntries.content:
-Send a Redstone signal to the engine to start the launch sequence.  You have 10 seconds to board before liftoff.

-During ascent, press JUMP when prompted to detach the spent boosters, leaving just the Command Module.

-As you fall toward the Moon, fire your landing engine with JUMP right before impact to slow your descent for a safe touchdown.

howToEntries.heading: Explore!
howToEntries.content: -Search craters and structures: Outposts, Crashed Probes, Quarries, and Assembly Pits, for materials and gear.

howToEntries.heading: Summon the Mothership!
howToEntries.content:
-Find a Transmitter Station and climb to the top to summon the Mothership!

-Fight through the "Architects" guarding the site and claim your rewards, including the rare Fusion Core that can be used to craft a powerful Blaster.
